purpose: Empirically isolate whether the already-present R5 hash-cons memoization saves exact repeated child work on collision-rich formulas where two independently verified OR-lift branches reach the same canonical residual fingerprint.

collision_construction.per_formula: seed partitions variables 2..13 into four triples. For every triple, form the complete eight-clause width-3 blocker containing all sign patterns. Lift every base clause C into both (selector OR C) and (-selector OR C).
collision_construction.base_child_UNSAT_reason: each complete eight-clause blocker excludes all 2^3 assignments to its triple; conjunction is therefore UNSAT
collision_construction.expected_hash_cons_collision: after first exact child is decided UNSAT, the second selector branch has the identical canonical fingerprint and must reuse the memoized result rather than execute a second C025 child call

benchmark_preconditions.independent_truth_oracle: brute-force all 2^13 assignments on root; require UNSAT
benchmark_preconditions.exact_collision: unchanged C025 restrict(root,1,0) and restrict(root,1,1) must be exactly equal and have identical fingerprint
benchmark_preconditions.selector_policy: unchanged R5 branch_pressure must select selector variable 1 at root
benchmark_preconditions.canonical_root: unchanged C025 must return OPEN; if not, formula remains in frozen holdout and benchmark precondition fails rather than replacing the formula
benchmark_preconditions.child_leaf: unchanged C025 on the shared child must return replay-confirmed UNSAT

counterfactual_no_sharing.method: run unchanged C025 on the identical shared child twice as two independent calls under the same C1/K0/width3 profile
required: both independent child calls return byte-identical replay-confirmed UNSAT
no-sharing exact child work equals the sum of both independent calls
actual R5 child exact work is compared against that no-sharing total

gate.speedup_scope: only repeated-child exact work saved inside this frozen collision-rich construction; no general solver speedup claim
